name: @pipeworx/mcp-finra

tools.name: short_volume_daily
tools.description: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume for one symbol on one trading day, summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility (Nasdaq TRF Carteret, NYSE TRF, Nasdaq TRF Chicago) so the total matches FINRA's consolidated CNMS figure. Returns short_volume, short_exempt_volume, total_volume, short_ratio (short / total), and the per-facility breakdown. Publishing lag is T+1 or better; omit `date` for the most recent published day. Zero-rated: FINRA's terms forbid charging for this data, so the call costs 0 credits.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Defaults to the most recent published trading day.

tools.name: short_volume_history
tools.description: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume time series for one symbol — up to 30 trading days ending at `end_date` (default: most recent published day). Each day carries short_volume, short_exempt_volume, total_volume and short_ratio summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility, so the daily totals match FINRA's consolidated CNMS figures. Use it to see how a symbol's short-sale share of volume moved over recent sessions. Zero-rated: costs 0 credits.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD; defaults to most recent published day

tools.name: short_volume_top
tools.description: Ranks symbols on a given trading day by short_ratio (short_volume / total_volume) using FINRA Reg SHO daily data summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility. Scans the whole published day (~12,000 symbols) and returns the highest-ratio names. Useful for spotting heavily-shorted names; raise min_total_volume to exclude thinly-traded micro-caps. Zero-rated: costs 0 credits.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD; defaults to most recent published day

min_total_volume.description: Skip symbols below this consolidated total volume (default 100000)

tools.name: short_interest
tools.description: FINRA consolidated SHORT INTEREST for one symbol — the bi-monthly settlement-date data: total open short position, days-to-cover, average daily volume, and change vs the prior settlement. This is the "% short / days-to-cover" metric investors cite — DISTINCT from short_volume_daily (daily short-sale VOLUME). Returns the latest settlement plus recent history, plus the FINRA attribution the data is licensed under. Zero-rated: FINRA's terms forbid charging for it, so this call costs 0 credits.

limit.description: How many recent settlements to return (1–24, default 6)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-finra forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the finra pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
